description: Department of Census and Statistics - National Consumer Price Index - June 2025
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for June 2025, published by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structural/personnel changes (Types 1-3) nor does it fit any specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial). The content represents statistical information dissemination, which falls under miscellaneous administrative matters not covered by the other specific categories.
